FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f

    ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName            AS category,
        sum(f.SalesAmount)                AS sales_amount,
        sum(f.ReturnAmount)               AS return_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
    GROUP BY category
)
SELECT
    category                            AS product_category_name,
    sales_amount                        AS sales_amount,
    return_amount                       AS return_amount,
    sales_amount - return_amount        AS net_sales_amount
FROM base
ORDER BY net_sales_amount DESC

WITH order_sales AS (
    SELECT
        SalesOrderNumber,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS order_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales_amount
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
      AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
)
SELECT
    countIf(o.order_sales_amount > 1000) AS order_count,
    sumIf(o.order_sales_amount, o.order_sales_amount > 1000) AS high_value_sales_amount,
    any(t.total_sales_amount) AS total_sales_amount,
    sumIf(o.order_sales_amount, o.order_sales_amount > 1000) / any(t.total_sales_amount) * 100 AS high_value_sales_pct
FROM order_sales AS o
CROSS JOIN total_sales AS t
turns.assumption: 未说明渠道，按线上销售；单笔金额按同一订单号 SalesOrderNumber 的 SalesAmount 合计计算。

turns.query:
WITH customer_metrics AS
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales,
        uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) AS order_count
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
customer_value AS
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        total_sales,
        order_count,
        total_sales / nullIf(order_count, 0) AS avg_order_value
    FROM customer_metrics
),
scored AS
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        total_sales,
        order_count,
        avg_order_value,
        ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC, CustomerKey) AS order_count_decile,
        ntile(10) OVER (ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC, CustomerKey) AS avg_order_value_decile,
        rank() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_count_rank,
        rank() OVER (ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC) AS avg_order_value_rank
    FROM customer_value
)
SELECT
    s.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName AS FirstName,
    c.LastName AS LastName,
    s.order_count AS order_count,
    s.total_sales AS total_sales,
    s.avg_order_value AS avg_order_value,
    s.order_count_rank AS order_count_rank,
    s.avg_order_value_rank AS avg_order_value_rank,
    s.order_count_decile AS order_count_decile,
    s.avg_order_value_decile AS avg_order_value_decile
FROM scored AS s
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c ON s.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE s.order_count_decile = 1
  AND s.avg_order_value_decile = 1
ORDER BY s.order_count_rank, s.avg_order_value_rank, s.CustomerKey
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 全区间按客户去重订单数计算订单数、销售额÷订单数计算客单价，并用 ntile(10) 分别取前 10%（边界并列按 CustomerKey 决定）。

turns.query:
WITH
    customer_metrics AS (
        SELECT
            CustomerKey,
            uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber) AS order_count,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS total_sales,
            sum(SalesAmount) / nullIf(uniqExact(SalesOrderNumber), 0) AS avg_order_value
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        GROUP BY CustomerKey
    ),
    thresholds AS (
        SELECT
            quantileExact(0.9)(order_count) AS order_count_p90,
            quantileExact(0.9)(avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value_p90,
            count() AS total_customers
        FROM customer_metrics
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            m.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
            m.order_count AS order_count,
            m.total_sales AS total_sales,
            m.avg_order_value AS avg_order_value,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY m.order_count DESC) AS order_count_rank,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY m.avg_order_value DESC) AS avg_order_value_rank
        FROM customer_metrics AS m
    )
SELECT
    c.CustomerKey AS CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName AS FirstName,
    c.LastName AS LastName,
    r.order_count AS order_count,
    r.avg_order_value AS avg_order_value,
    r.total_sales AS total_sales,
    r.order_count_rank AS order_count_rank,
    r.avg_order_value_rank AS avg_order_value_rank,
    t.total_customers AS total_customers,
    t.order_count_p90 AS order_count_p90,
    t.avg_order_value_p90 AS avg_order_value_p90
FROM ranked AS r
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c ON r.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
CROSS JOIN thresholds AS t

WITH
    store_year AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008) AS sales_2008,
            sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009) AS sales_2009
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
        GROUP BY StoreKey
        HAVING sales_2008 > 0 AND sales_2009 > 0
    ),
    ranked_stores AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sales_2008 - sales_2009                                                             AS store_decline_amount,
            (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / sales_2008 * 100                                        AS store_decline_pct,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / sales_2008 DESC)                  AS store_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY (sales_2008 - sales_2009) / sales_2008 DESC, StoreKey)  AS store_rn
        FROM store_year
        WHERE sales_2009 < sales_2008
    ),
    cat_year AS (
        SELECT
            f.StoreKey                                      AS StoreKey,
            pc.ProductCategoryName                          AS category,
            sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2008)  AS cat_sales_2008,
            sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009)  AS cat_sales_2009
        FROM retail.FactSales AS f
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
        WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
          AND f.StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM ranked_stores WHERE store_rn <= 3)
        GROUP BY StoreKey, category
    ),
    cat_rank AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            category,
            cat_sales_2008 - cat_sales_2009                                                             AS category_decline_amount,
            (cat_sales_2008 - cat_sales_2009) / cat_sales_2008 * 100                                     AS category_decline_pct,
            rank() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY cat_sales_2008 - cat_sales_2009 DESC)            AS category_rank,
            row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY cat_sales_2008 - cat_sales_2009 DESC, category) AS category_rn
        FROM cat_year
    )
SELECT
    t.StoreKey                                       AS StoreKey,
    s.StoreName                                      AS StoreName,
    t.store_decline_pct                              AS store_decline_pct,
    t.store_decline_amount                           AS store_decline_amount,
    c.category                                       AS category,
    c.category_decline_amount                        AS category_decline_amount,
    c.category_decline_pct                           AS category_decline_pct,
    c.category_decline_amount / t.store_decline_amount * 100 AS category_share_of_store_decline_pct,
    t.store_rank                                     AS store_rank,
    c.category_rank                                  AS category_rank
FROM ranked_stores AS t
INNER JOIN cat_rank AS c ON t.StoreKey = c.StoreKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON t.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
WHERE t.store_rn <= 3
  AND c.category_rn = 1
ORDER BY t.store_rn
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')

        GROUP BY ProductKey, DateKey

SELECT

WITH
    cost AS
    (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(TotalCost) AS total_cost_2009
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    inv_daily AS
    (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            DateKey,
            sum(OnHandQuantity * UnitCost) AS day_inventory_value
        FROM retail.FactInventory
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY ProductKey, DateKey
    ),
    inv_sum AS
    (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(day_inventory_value) AS inventory_value_sum,
            count()                  AS snapshot_days_present
        FROM inv_daily
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    snapshot_days AS
    (
        SELECT uniqExact(DateKey) AS n_snapshot_dates
        FROM retail.FactInventory
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
    )
SELECT
    c.ProductKey                                                                   AS ProductKey,
    p.ProductName                                                                  AS ProductName,
    c.total_cost_2009                                                              AS total_cost_2009,
    s.inventory_value_sum                                                          AS inventory_value_sum_2009,
    d.n_snapshot_dates                                                             AS snapshot_days,
    s.inventory_value_sum / d.n_snapshot_dates                                     AS avg_inventory_value,
    c.total_cost_2009 / nullIf(s.inventory_value_sum / d.n_snapshot_dates, 0)      AS inventory_turnover
FROM cost AS c
LEFT JOIN inv_sum AS s ON c.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON c.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
CROSS JOIN snapshot_days AS d
ORDER BY inventory_turnover DESC, c.ProductKey

    store_actual AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND DateKey <  toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ),
    store_target AS
    (
        SELECT
            q.StoreKey,
            sum(q.SalesAmountQuota) AS target_sales
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota AS q
        INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario AS sc ON q.ScenarioKey = sc.ScenarioKey
        WHERE sc.ScenarioName = 'Budget'
          AND q.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND q.DateKey <  toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY q.StoreKey
    ),
    store_metrics AS
    (
        SELECT
            s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
            s.StoreName AS StoreName,
            coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) AS actual_sales,
            coalesce(t.target_sales, 0) AS target_sales,
            coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) / nullIf(coalesce(t.target_sales, 0), 0) * 100 AS achievement_pct
        FROM retail.DimStore AS s
        LEFT JOIN store_actual AS a ON s.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
        LEFT JOIN store_target AS t ON s.StoreKey = t.StoreKey
    ),
    ranked AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            actual_sales,
            target_sales,
            achievement_pct,
            rank()       OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct DESC) AS high_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct DESC, StoreKey) AS high_rn,
            rank()       OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct ASC)  AS low_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct ASC, StoreKey)  AS low_rn
        FROM store_metrics
    )
SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    target_sales,
    achievement_pct,
    multiIf(high_rn <= 5, 'highest', 'lowest') AS ranking_group,
    multiIf(high_rn <= 5, high_rank, low_rank) AS rank_in_group
FROM ranked
WHERE high_rn <= 5
   OR low_rn <= 5
ORDER BY ranking_group, rank_in_group, StoreKey

WITH

        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ),
    target AS (
        SELECT

        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
        WHERE ScenarioKey = 2
          AND DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ),
    store_metrics AS (
        SELECT
            s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
            s.StoreName AS StoreName,
            ifNull(a.actual_sales, 0) AS actual_sales,
            t.target_sales AS target_sales,
            ifNull(a.actual_sales, 0) / nullIf(t.target_sales, 0) * 100 AS achievement_pct
        FROM retail.DimStore AS s
        INNER JOIN target AS t ON s.StoreKey = t.StoreKey
        LEFT JOIN actual AS a ON s.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
        WHERE t.target_sales > 0
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            actual_sales,
            target_sales,
            achievement_pct,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct DESC) AS high_rank,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct ASC) AS low_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct DESC, StoreKey) AS high_rn,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY achievement_pct ASC, StoreKey) AS low_rn
        FROM store_metrics
    ),
    top_bottom AS (
        SELECT
            'highest_5' AS result_group,
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            actual_sales,
            target_sales,
            achievement_pct,
            high_rank AS achievement_rank,
            high_rn AS ordering
        FROM ranked
        WHERE high_rn <= 5

        UNION ALL

        SELECT
            'lowest_5' AS result_group,
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            actual_sales,
            target_sales,
            achievement_pct,
            low_rank AS achievement_rank,
            low_rn AS ordering
        FROM ranked
        WHERE low_rn <= 5
    )
SELECT
    result_group,
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    target_sales,
    achievement_pct,
    achievement_rank
FROM top_bottom
ORDER BY result_group, ordering

WITH
    actual AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND DateKey <  toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ),
    target AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS target_sales
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
        WHERE ScenarioKey = 2
          AND DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND DateKey <  toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY StoreKey
    ),
    store_rate AS
    (
        SELECT
            s.StoreKey AS StoreKey,
            s.StoreName AS StoreName,
            coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) AS actual_sales,
            coalesce(t.target_sales, 0) AS target_sales,
            if(
                t.target_sales IS NULL OR t.target_sales = 0,
                NULL,
                coalesce(a.actual_sales, 0) / t.target_sales * 100
            ) AS attainment_pct
        FROM retail.DimStore AS s
        LEFT JOIN actual AS a ON s.StoreKey = a.StoreKey
        LEFT JOIN target AS t ON s.StoreKey = t.StoreKey
    ),
    ranked AS
    (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            StoreName,
            actual_sales,
            target_sales,
            attainment_pct,
            rank()       OVER (ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC)                    AS highest_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC, StoreKey)          AS highest_rn,
            rank()       OVER (ORDER BY attainment_pct ASC)                     AS lowest_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY attainment_pct ASC, StoreKey)           AS lowest_rn
        FROM store_rate
    )
SELECT
    StoreKey,
    StoreName,
    actual_sales,
    target_sales,
    attainment_pct,
    actual_sales - target_sales AS actual_minus_target,
    if(highest_rn <= 5, 'highest', 'lowest') AS rate_group,
    if(highest_rn <= 5, highest_rank, lowest_rank) AS rate_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE highest_rn <= 5
   OR lowest_rn <= 5
ORDER BY rate_group, rate_rank, StoreKey
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

WITH
    classes AS (
        SELECT 'A' AS abc_class
        UNION ALL SELECT 'B'
        UNION ALL SELECT 'C'
    ),
    product_sales AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(SalesAmount) AS revenue
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
          AND DateKey < toDate('2010-01-01')
        GROUP BY ProductKey
        HAVING sum(SalesAmount) > 0
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            revenue,
            sum(revenue) OVER (
                ORDER BY revenue DESC, ProductKey
                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) AS cumulative_revenue,
            sum(revenue) OVER () AS total_revenue
        FROM product_sales
    ),
    classified AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            revenue,
            cumulative_revenue,
            total_revenue,
            multiIf(
                cumulative_revenue <= 0.80 * total_revenue, 'A',
                cumulative_revenue <= 0.95 * total_revenue, 'B',
                'C'
            ) AS abc_class
        FROM ranked
    ),
    class_agg AS (
        SELECT
            abc_class,
            count() AS product_count,
            sum(revenue) AS revenue
        FROM classified
        GROUP BY abc_class
    ),
    grand_total AS (
        SELECT sum(revenue) AS total_revenue
        FROM product_sales
    )
SELECT
    c.abc_class AS abc_class,
    a.product_count AS product_count,
    a.revenue AS revenue,
    t.total_revenue AS total_revenue,
    a.revenue / t.total_revenue * 100 AS revenue_share_pct
FROM classes AS c
LEFT JOIN class_agg AS a ON c.abc_class = a.abc_class
CROSS JOIN grand_total AS t
ORDER BY c.abc_class

WITH
    sales_90d AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(SalesQuantity) AS sales_quantity_90d
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-10-03')
          AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
        GROUP BY ProductKey
        HAVING sum(SalesQuantity) > 0
    ),
    current_inv AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(on_hand_quantity) AS current_inventory_quantity
        FROM (
            SELECT
                StoreKey,
                ProductKey,
                argMax(OnHandQuantity, DateKey) AS on_hand_quantity
            FROM retail.FactInventory
            GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
        )
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    calc AS (
        SELECT
            s.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
            coalesce(p.ProductName, toString(s.ProductKey)) AS product_name,
            ifNull(ci.current_inventory_quantity, 0) AS current_inventory_quantity,
            s.sales_quantity_90d AS sales_quantity_90d,
            s.sales_quantity_90d / 90.0 AS avg_daily_sales_quantity,
            ifNull(ci.current_inventory_quantity, 0) / (s.sales_quantity_90d / 90.0) AS days_of_supply
        FROM sales_90d AS s
        LEFT JOIN current_inv AS ci ON s.ProductKey = ci.ProductKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            product_name,
            current_inventory_quantity,
            sales_quantity_90d,
            avg_daily_sales_quantity,
            days_of_supply,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY days_of_supply ASC) AS days_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY days_of_supply ASC, ProductKey) AS rn
        FROM calc
    )
SELECT
    ProductKey AS product_key,
    product_name,
    current_inventory_quantity,
    sales_quantity_90d,
    avg_daily_sales_quantity,
    days_of_supply,
    days_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 20
ORDER BY rn
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

WITH customer_year AS
(
    SELECT
        f.CustomerKey                         AS CustomerKey,
        uniqExact(d.CalendarQuarterLabel)     AS active_quarters,
        sum(f.SalesAmount)                    AS annual_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d
        ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
    HAVING active_quarters = 4
),
ranked AS
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        active_quarters,
        annual_sales,
        rank() OVER (ORDER BY annual_sales DESC) AS sales_rank,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY annual_sales DESC, CustomerKey) AS rn
    FROM customer_year
)
SELECT
    r.sales_rank       AS sales_rank,
    r.CustomerKey      AS CustomerKey,
    c.FirstName        AS FirstName,
    c.LastName         AS LastName,
    r.active_quarters  AS active_quarters,
    r.annual_sales     AS annual_sales
FROM ranked AS r
INNER JOIN retail.DimCustomer AS c
    ON r.CustomerKey = c.CustomerKey
WHERE r.rn <= 20
ORDER BY r.rn

WITH customer_stats AS
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
        uniqExact(ProductKey) AS product_types,
        max(DateKey) AS last_purchase_date
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey
),
segmented AS
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        total_spend,
        product_types,
        multiIf(
            dateDiff('month', last_purchase_date, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 6, '活跃',
            dateDiff('month', last_purchase_date, toDate('2009-12-31')) <= 12, '有流失风险',
            '已流失'
        ) AS customer_segment
    FROM customer_stats
)
SELECT
    customer_segment,
    count() AS customer_count,
    avg(total_spend) AS avg_spend_amount,
    avg(product_types) AS avg_product_types
FROM segmented
GROUP BY customer_segment
ORDER BY multiIf(customer_segment = '活跃', 1, customer_segment = '有流失风险', 2, 3)

WITH
    latest_inventory AS (
        SELECT
            i.StoreKey      AS StoreKey,
            i.ProductKey    AS ProductKey,
            i.OnHandQuantity AS OnHandQuantity
        FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
        INNER JOIN
        (
            SELECT
                StoreKey,
                ProductKey,
                max(DateKey) AS max_date
            FROM retail.FactInventory
            GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
        ) AS m
            ON i.StoreKey = m.StoreKey
           AND i.ProductKey = m.ProductKey
           AND i.DateKey = m.max_date
    ),
    current_inventory AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(OnHandQuantity) AS current_inventory
        FROM latest_inventory
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    sales_90d AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(SalesQuantity) AS sales_qty_90d
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-10-03')
          AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    product_days AS (
        SELECT
            ci.ProductKey                                                   AS ProductKey,
            ci.current_inventory                                            AS current_inventory,
            s.sales_qty_90d                                                 AS sales_qty_90d,
            s.sales_qty_90d / 90                                            AS avg_daily_sales,
            ci.current_inventory / nullIf(s.sales_qty_90d / 90, 0)          AS supply_days
        FROM current_inventory AS ci
        INNER JOIN sales_90d AS s ON ci.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
        WHERE s.sales_qty_90d > 0
    ),
    ranked AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            current_inventory,
            sales_qty_90d,
            avg_daily_sales,
            supply_days,
            rank() OVER (ORDER BY supply_days ASC) AS days_rank,
            row_number() OVER (ORDER BY supply_days ASC, ProductKey) AS rn
        FROM product_days
    )
SELECT
    r.ProductKey                                                        AS ProductKey,
    coalesce(p.ProductName, toString(r.ProductKey))                     AS ProductName,
    r.current_inventory                                                 AS current_inventory,
    r.sales_qty_90d                                                     AS sales_qty_90d,
    r.avg_daily_sales                                                   AS avg_daily_sales,
    r.supply_days                                                       AS supply_days,
    r.days_rank                                                         AS days_rank
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON r.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE r.rn <= 20
ORDER BY r.rn
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        max(DateKey) AS last_purchase_date,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS total_spend,
        uniqExact(ProductKey) AS product_kind_count
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY CustomerKey

customer_recency AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        total_spend,
        product_kind_count,
        dateDiff('month', last_purchase_date, toDate('2009-12-31')) AS recency_months
    FROM customer_stats

        multiIf(
            recency_months <= 6, '活跃',

        ) AS customer_status,
        multiIf(
            recency_months <= 6, 1,
            recency_months <= 12, 2,

        ) AS status_order

    customer_status,

    avg(total_spend) AS avg_spend_amount,
    avg(product_kind_count) AS avg_product_kind_count

WITH
    latest_inv AS (
        SELECT
            StoreKey,
            ProductKey,
            argMax(OnHandQuantity, DateKey) AS on_hand
        FROM retail.FactInventory
        GROUP BY StoreKey, ProductKey
    ),
    inv AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(on_hand) AS current_inventory
        FROM latest_inv
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    sales90 AS (
        SELECT
            ProductKey,
            sum(SalesQuantity) AS sales_qty_90d
        FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-10-03')
          AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
        GROUP BY ProductKey
    ),
    calc AS (
        SELECT
            i.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
            i.current_inventory AS current_inventory,
            ifNull(s.sales_qty_90d, 0) AS sales_qty_90d,
            ifNull(s.sales_qty_90d, 0) / 90.0 AS avg_daily_sales,
            i.current_inventory / nullIf(ifNull(s.sales_qty_90d, 0) / 90.0, 0) AS days_of_supply
        FROM inv AS i
        LEFT JOIN sales90 AS s ON i.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
    )
SELECT
    ProductKey,
    ProductName,
    current_inventory,
    sales_qty_90d,
    avg_daily_sales,
    days_of_supply,
    days_rank
FROM
(
    SELECT
        c.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
        coalesce(p.ProductName, toString(c.ProductKey)) AS ProductName,
        c.current_inventory AS current_inventory,
        c.sales_qty_90d AS sales_qty_90d,
        c.avg_daily_sales AS avg_daily_sales,
        c.days_of_supply AS days_of_supply,
        rank() OVER (ORDER BY c.days_of_supply ASC) AS days_rank,
        row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c.days_of_supply ASC, c.ProductKey) AS rn

    GROUP BY fp.CustomerKey, fp.cohort_year
)
SELECT
    cohort_year,
    count() AS cohort_customers,
    sum(has_later_year) AS returning_customers,
    sum(has_later_year) / count() * 100 AS returning_customer_pct
FROM customer_return
GROUP BY cohort_year
ORDER BY cohort_year;
turns.assumption: 「之后的年份」指首次购买年份之后的日历年内至少有一次购买记录，购买取线上销售表的全部行（含仅退货行），首购日为每个客户的最早购买日。

WITH
    q AS (
        SELECT
            pc.ProductCategoryName  AS ProductCategoryName,
            d.CalendarQuarterLabel  AS quarter,
            sum(f.SalesAmount)      AS quarter_sales
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
        INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
        LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
        WHERE d.CalendarYear = 2009
        GROUP BY ProductCategoryName, quarter
    ),
    c AS (
        SELECT
            ProductCategoryName,
            sum(quarter_sales)             AS annual_sales_amount,
            max(quarter_sales)             AS peak_quarter_sales,
            argMax(quarter, quarter_sales) AS peak_quarter
        FROM q
        GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
    )
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    peak_quarter_sales / annual_sales_amount * 100                       AS peak_quarter_share_pct,
    peak_quarter,
    peak_quarter_sales,
    annual_sales_amount,
    rank() OVER (ORDER BY peak_quarter_sales / annual_sales_amount DESC) AS dependency_rank
FROM c
ORDER BY dependency_rank
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 问题中的“全年”按约定取 2009 年，依赖程度定义为全年销售额中最高单季度销售额占比；未说明渠道，按默认的线上销售 FactOnlineSales 计算。

turns.query:
WITH agg AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName AS product_category_name,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2007) AS sales_2007,
        sumIf(f.TotalCost, d.CalendarYear = 2007) AS cost_2007,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2008) AS sales_2008,
        sumIf(f.TotalCost, d.CalendarYear = 2008) AS cost_2008,
        sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2009) AS sales_2009,
        sumIf(f.TotalCost, d.CalendarYear = 2009) AS cost_2009
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2007, 2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
)
SELECT
    product_category_name,
    2007 AS year,
    sales_2007 AS sales_amount,
    cost_2007 AS total_cost,
    sales_2007 - cost_2007 AS gross_profit,
    (sales_2007 - cost_2007) / nullIf(sales_2007, 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct,
    CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)) AS margin_change_pp
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    product_category_name,
    2008 AS year,
    sales_2008 AS sales_amount,
    cost_2008 AS total_cost,
    sales_2008 - cost_2008 AS gross_profit,
    (sales_2008 - cost_2008) / nullIf(sales_2008, 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct,
    ((sales_2008 - cost_2008) / nullIf(sales_2008, 0) - (sales_2007 - cost_2007) / nullIf(sales_2007, 0)) * 100 AS margin_change_pp
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT
    product_category_name,
    2009 AS year,
    sales_2009 AS sales_amount,
    cost_2009 AS total_cost,
    sales_2009 - cost_2009 AS gross_profit,
    (sales_2009 - cost_2009) / nullIf(sales_2009, 0) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct,
    ((sales_2009 - cost_2009) / nullIf(sales_2009, 0) - (sales_2008 - cost_2008) / nullIf(sales_2008, 0)) * 100 AS margin_change_pp
FROM agg
ORDER BY product_category_name, year
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 未指定渠道，按约定使用线上销售 FactOnlineSales；毛利率=(销售额−总成本)/销售额，逐年变化为相邻年份毛利率之差（百分点），缺失产品品类保留为 NULL。

WITH daily AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ProductCategoryName  AS ProductCategoryName,
        f.DateKey               AS DateKey,
        any(d.IsWorkDay)        AS day_type,
        sum(f.SalesAmount)      AS day_sales
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimDate AS d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    GROUP BY ProductCategoryName, DateKey
)
SELECT
    ProductCategoryName,
    avgIf(day_sales, day_type = 'WeekEnd')                                AS avg_weekend_day_sales,
    avgIf(day_sales, day_type = 'WorkDay')                                AS avg_weekday_sales,
    avg_weekend_day_sales - avg_weekday_sales                             AS weekend_difference_amount,
    (avg_weekend_day_sales - avg_weekday_sales) / avg_weekday_sales * 100 AS weekend_lift_pct
FROM daily
GROUP BY ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY ProductCategoryName
SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
turns.assumption: 未说明渠道时按约定使用线上销售，取 2007-01-01 至 2009-12-31 全区间，周末与工作日按 DimDate.IsWorkDay 区分。
